entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to make a return.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex with VeloFit support. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number to start?

Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 19th, so about 38 days ago. To proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Are you experiencing a technical fault or is it more of a preference issue?
It just didn't work out. I want to return it.

I understand. Sometimes it just takes a bit of adjustment. Before I process a return, I just want to make sure you're aware of the heart rate zone calibration feature. It can really customize the experience...

Look, I don't need a tutorial. We had an **emergency** right before my partner's military **deployment**. I ended up in the **hospital** and needed **surgery**. I haven't exactly had time to worry about a fitness band.
Oh, my goodness. I am so sorry to hear all that. I certainly hope you're on the road to recovery. That's completely understandable. Let me just pull up the return policy for this item right now.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and since your purchase was 38 days ago, you're well within our 90-day return window.
So you didn't even need my whole life story. Fine.

Well, you are well within the standard timeframe regardless. I've gone ahead and approved this return for a full refund. I'm generating the prepaid shipping label and instructions now and sending them to the email we have on file. You should receive it in the next 5 minutes.
The email is on its way. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
